extension.description: Search Thunder subtitles by video CID and filename, or enter a title manually. Download text subtitles and ZIP archives, with optional UTF-8 encoding and Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion.
通过视频 CID 和文件名搜索迅雷字幕，也可手动输入片名。支持文本字幕、ZIP 字幕包、UTF-8 编码和简繁转换。
依目前播放的影片比對並下載迅雷中文字幕，支援 UTF-8 編碼及簡繁轉換。
extension.news:
0.3.1 Add licence and source notices, replace inherited artwork and prepare official repository metadata. Remove obsolete converter command-line code.
0.3.0 Combine CID matching with HTTPS name search and support manual title lookup. Keep partial results if one search service fails.
